svg.title: Before any training: how much more active each scrambled circuit is than the real one
svg.desc: Dots, one per scrambled circuit, 64 in all, grouped by what each kind of scrambling keeps. Every dot is to the right of zero, so the real circuit is the quietest. Circuits that keep each block's own synapse strengths sit within 0.2% to 8.2%; the rest range up to 186%.
svg.text: Output activity before training, compared with the real circuit
0% = exactly as active as the real circuit. Each dot is one scrambled circuit (64 in all).

g.text: Keeps each block's own synapse strengths
Keeps cell-type and side blocks, shuffles strengths
Keeps each neuron's number of links
